messages:
pagerbot: PAGER — meter_count_alerts (prod-billing) triggered: token_count_drift > 35% for eu1. Pager: https://pagerduty/INC-1770135799
maya.k: acked. i'm on triage.
mike.s: seeing delayed usage ingestion from emitter-3, backlog ~12h. counts spike aligns with retries.
maya.k: can someone run a quick sanity query on the ledger?
mike.s: `/opt/infra/sql> SELECT sum(tokens) FROM usage_events WHERE ingest_time > now() - interval '1 day';` returns 1.7M vs expected 1.1M
natalie.p: overage flags for ~1.2k customers were emitted ~30m ago. billing-service still processing delivery queue.
billing-team: halting overage notifications (feature-flag) — executing: `POST /admin/flags/overage_notifications?enable=false`
maya.k: rolling back emitter-3 to commit bc9f2 to stop duplicate replays
eng-ops: initiated restart of emitter-3 pod — `kubectl rollout restart deploy/emitter-3 -n prod`
mike.s: logs show duplicate ack loop after transient DB timeout, patch queued (PR #482)
maya.k: temp mitigation: switch billing aggregator to shadow-mode (use stable snapshot) — `billing.agg.mode=shadow`
billing-team: confirmed pause successful, no new customer emails being sent :thumbsup: 
pagerbot: customer-impact: medium — possible overcharge flags delivered; CS notified.
natalie.p: CS pinged, templated message drafted. will hold broad customer notify pending reconciliation results.
maya.k: monitoring: re-ingest rate normalized after restart. KV-cache hit ratio back to baseline.
mike.s: starting reconciliation to dedupe duplicates: `python tools/reconcile_tokens.py --window 24h --dedupe true` — kicking off now
billing-team: reconcile job running, ETA ~22m
maya.k: recommend delaying billing cycle close for affected window by 4h to avoid invoices with duplicates
natalie.p: accepted. scheduling customer notices and precautionary credits for impacted tenants.
mike.s: PR #482 merged, emitter retry logic hardened. watch for recurrence.
pagerbot: severity lowered to S2 at 1770135980
maya.k: create incident writeup and postmortem + action items when stable
billing-team: action items: 1) emitter circuit-breaker 2) auto-pause overage-notifs on drift 3) metric for duplicate-ack rate
natalie.p: assigning owners in JIRA: BILL-237, INFRA-482, CS-129
mike.s: last check: token delta trending back to expected within 1h windows
maya.k: handing off monitoring to next shift `sre-oncall` for overnight watch
sre-oncall: ack, monitoring until 1770136120
pagerbot: RESOLVED at 1770136120 — root cause: emitter retry loop caused duplicated events after transient DB ack failures. Follow-up: postmortem in #postmortems
